notes: BIDI module: one path uses 1330 nm TX / 1270 nm RX (BIDI-SFP+-ER-33); ordering also lists BIDI-SFP+-ER-27 (1270 nm TX variant per description). Product features cite industrial operating case temperature -40 to 85 °C (symbol TI in General Operating Characteristics); ordering table lists 0 °C to +70 °C for both part numbers. Power consumption stated as < 1.2 W. Transmitter average output power and receiver average receive power figures noted informative only per IEEE 802.3ae. Receiver sensitivity measured with worst ER=6, BER<10^-12, 2^31-1 PRBS. Dispersion penalty (TDP) max 3.2 dB stated without paired penalized optical parameter and operating condition. RMS spectral width max 1 nm. Optical rise/fall time (20%-80%) max 50 ps. RIN max -128 dB/Hz. Supply current Icc5 max 330 mA at 3.13-3.47 V Vcc.
